meme.title: 통닭 털어 놓고 친구를 고발함
meme.scene: ONE LOCKED-OFF CAMERA for panels 1-5: a static camera standing on the floor at dog eye level, vertical 9:16, exactly the same framing, position, lens, kitchen background and lighting in panels 1-5, like frames of one uncut 10-second shot; only poses change. Bright modern home kitchen, white cabinets, a window behind, light wood floor, cool daylight. Foreground center on the floor: a torn-apart, half-eaten greasy human roast chicken - ripped skin, pulled-off drumsticks, bare bones, shredded meat and grease smears scattered around (NOT a whole intact chicken). Middle background between and behind the two dogs: the owner (a man in a grey sweatshirt, dark joggers, grey socks), framed so the TOP EDGE OF THE PICTURE CUTS HIM AT CHEST LEVEL - no head, no face anywhere. Both dogs are realistic adult Shiba Inus with real proportions, no clothes, no collars. No text, no watermark.
panels: 0s: owner bent forward, one hand pointing down at the torn chicken, the other on his knee; Shiba A sits upright, chin up, shameless face; Shiba B sits hunched, head lowered, ears flattened back, guilty eyes looking up. [CAST CHECK - must be true in this panel: exactly TWO dogs visible, both fully inside the frame. LEFT dog = Shiba A: red-orange (fox-red) coat with cream chest and cream cheeks, sits on the LEFT side of the chicken. RIGHT dog = Shiba B: pale cream-white coat with faint sesame shading, slightly smaller, sits on the RIGHT side of the chicken. The dogs never swap sides, never change colour, never leave the frame. The owner is cropped by the top edge of the frame at chest level: his head and face are NEVER visible, only his grey sweatshirt torso, arms, hands, dark joggers and grey socks.]
